events.title: Patch 0.0.7 & 0.0.8
events.summary: Hello, friends! You've really fired us up with all your feedback, and now we're working like there's no tomorrow! We're fixing bugs, polishing mechanics, and pushing forward at full speed. Thank you for keeping us motivated! We also have some big news to share! In ATOM RPG 2, you'll be able to choose where your story begins. Each starting path will have its own story, but eventually they'll all come together, like streams flowing into one river. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45968120/8944c2d17c308450b8afd5

Hey friends! Development is moving forward! We're fixing bugs, polishing game systems, and improving the game based on your feedback. A big thank you to everyone sharing constructive feedback - it really helps us! And to those losing patience, hang in there! We're working on it! :) Thanks for your support! Changelog 0.0.6 Added - First-person view, including supported vehicle seats. - New tutorial quests for gathering, cooking, building and healing. - New Resistance patrol and ambush missions. -
